entities.summary: Jin Xuefei is a Chinese American poet and novelist who uses the pen name Ha Jin (哈金). The name Ha comes from his favorite city, Harbin. His poetry is associated with the Misty Poetry movement. Ha Jin was a writers & intellectuals from Jinzhou (b. 1956-02-21, Jinzhou). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
